marked.min.js — vendored third-party library
=============================================

Package : marked
Version : 13.0.3
Source  : https://unpkg.com/marked@13.0.3/marked.min.js
          (official pre-built minified file published in the npm package
          itself — not re-minified by us or by a third-party CDN service)
License : MIT
Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked

Vendored on 2026-07-08 for Sherpa's offline manual viewer (web/manual.js).
No modifications were made to the file. It is loaded locally
(web/vendor/marked.min.js) — never from a CDN — to keep Sherpa's UI
fully usable without internet access (see docs/manual/offline-kit.md).
